name: rjhome
caption:
HOMETOWN KID 🎮🏀 Born in Toronto. Drafted by the Knicks. Now he's ours.

• Born in Toronto, godson of Steve Nash
• 2019 draft: New York takes him #3
• Dec 30, 2023: we trade for him. First game home: 19 points, 9 rebounds, a win
• 2024-25 with us: 21.1 PPG, 6.3 RPG, 5.4 APG
• First 9 games this season: 21.6 PPG, 6.1 RPG

Best Canadian to ever play for us? 👇

beats.head: TORONTO KID
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: RJ Barrett was born in Toronto. Steve Nash is his godfather. And the Knicks drafted him third overall.
beats.dlg: BORN IN TORONTO...|DRAFTED BY THE KNICKS.

beats.head: COMING HOME
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: Then we trade for him. His first game home: nineteen points and nine rebounds in a win.
beats.dlg: DEC 2023: HE COMES HOME.|DEBUT: 19 PTS, 9 REB.

beats.head: YEAR TWO
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: His first full year with us: twenty-one point one points, six rebounds, five assists.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: And through nine games this season: twenty-one point six points and six rebounds a night.

beats.head: BEST CANADIAN?
beats.vo: The kid from Toronto. Is he the best Canadian to ever play for us? Comment below.

facts.claim: Barrett was born in Toronto; godson of Steve Nash; drafted #3 (third overall) in the 2019 NBA draft by the New York Knicks; traded to Toronto December 30, 2023; first game with his hometown Raptors on January 1, 2024: 19 points and 9 rebounds in a 124-121 win over Cleveland
